faq.title: Before you buy
faq.note: If something is missing, ask on Discord: it gets answered before you buy, not after.

items.q: Do the scripts come with escrow?
items.a: No. You get the complete resource in Lua, commented and unencrypted. You can change the config, the text and the logic without breaking the licence.

items.q: Does it work with Qbox or with a custom framework?
items.a: Every script lists the frameworks it was tested on. The framework layer is isolated in a single file, so adapting it to your own is a matter of filling in four functions.
From the same download link as your Tebex purchase, which always serves the latest version. Changes are announced in the changelog with the version and a note on whether the database needs touching.
They are handled through Tebex following [your refund policy]. As a digital product shipped with its source, the norm is no refunds unless the script does not work and cannot be fixed.

items.q: Do you install it for me?
items.a: A standard install is something anyone can do by following the documentation. If you would rather I did it, or you need a specific integration, we agree that separately.

Restart the server and check usage with resmon 1.
